note: Every hunter shot carries rangeMin 8 (Auto/Aimed/Arcane/Concussive/Serpent Sting, spell-data from DBC SpellRange), and predicates.ts:318-338 derives the fighter's shoot-min from that equipped kit. Inside 8 yd the whole shot list is unusable, so the default band falls through to Raptor Strike {always} and the hunter trades white hits in melee. This variant makes every row that can ONLY fire in melee a hit-and-back-out at NOVA_KITE_STEP_BACK_YD (10 yd, classify.ts:931 - clears the 8 yd min with margin), and drops Multi-Shot and Volley, both gated enemyCount >= 2 and measured dead in a duel (pvpBands.defaultBandRowsNeedingASecondEnemy).
